how_to_apply: Download the notification and check your eligibility for the desired post.
Prepare a copy of bio-data and original/Xerox certificates of your educational qualification and experience.
Attend the walk-in interview and document verification on 15/10/2026.
Report for registration and document verification at the venue between 10:00 AM and 12:30 PM.
Proceed to the interview at Collectorate, Diu starting at 01:00 PM on 15/10/2026.
important_instructions: All above posts are purely on contract basis for the fixed period of 6 months under UT Plan. In case of continuation contract will be extended based on performance appraisal or till the post are filled up on regular basis. Graduate/Master/PG Degree/PG Diploma & valid registration is compulsory. Candidates having domicile certificate of UT of DNH, Daman & Diu will be given preference. For smooth functioning of Health Department, the Specialist need to be available on call as & when required and their residence to be compulsory in head quarter in public interest. Candidates can leave the head quarter after due approval of respective Head of Office, and an undertaking has to be given that he/she will not do any private practice. No T.A./D.A or any other claim shall be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is Health Department Diu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification for filling up 9 Specialist Doctor posts on a short-term contract basis under the UT Plan Fund through a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies available for various Specialist Doctor posts.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 15 October 2026 at 01:00 PM, with document verification and registration from 10:00 AM to 12:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Office of the Collector, Sewa Bhavan/ Collectorate, Diu.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years, with possible relaxation considered by the Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate, Master, PG Degree, PG Diploma, and valid registration compulsory for the respective specialist posts.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, these posts are purely on a contract basis for a fixed period of 6 months or until regular posts are filled up.
